en.html:
The Sword-Offering ceremony, it seemed, was already three days ago. Quite a long sleep I had taken.

With that in mind I inspected my body. Haan. Here, there, everywhere—the special aches one earned by sleeping too much.

Chachamaru"Clouds today. No good."
Kageaki"?"
Chachamaru"That sky over there. Cannot see Mount Fuji properly."
Kageaki"...Ah. This north-facing garden was designed for enjoying Fuji."
Chachamaru"Correct."
Chachamaru"From around here you get a proper view of the enormous hole in its belly. Interesting sight."
Kageaki"I see..."
Kageaki"Now, Your Excellency."
Chachamaru"Apun?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Chachamaru"Such formality, as though we are strangers."
Kageaki"We are strangers."
Chachamaru"Cold..."
Kageaki"May I ask why you brought me all the way to Izu?"
Chachamaru"Stayed in Kamakura, trouble would come. This month the Eastern Capital's defense and security were apun's responsibility."
Chachamaru"That Hachiman Shrine incident, you could call it my failure. So before Raichou and company started asking whose responsibility, apun took the initiative. Voluntary confinement at headquarters. In plain language, shut myself in."
Kageaki"...The incident at Hachiman Shrine..."
Chachamaru"Moriuji Ashikaga dead. One generation's great conqueror, and such an abrupt exit."
Kageaki"Is that—certain?"
Chachamaru"Kept from the outside. Even inside, officially he is still missing and being searched for. But he vanished along with Hachiman Shrine and his guards. Three days, not even a clue."
Chachamaru"Dead, that much is settled. At Fudaraku they have started preparing for a successor."
Kageaki"..."

ja.html:
茶々丸「今日は雲が張っててだめだな」
景明「？」
茶々丸「あっちの空。 　富士山がよく見えない」
景明「……あぁ。 　この北向きの庭は、富士を楽しむ仕立てで したか」
茶々丸「そっ」
茶々丸「この辺りからだと、富士山のどてっぱら・・・・・に 開いたでっかい穴がちゃんと見えて面白いん だよ」
景明「そうですか……」
景明「して、閣下」
茶々丸「あて？」
景明「はい」
茶々丸「そんな他人行儀な呼び方しなくても」
景明「他人です」
茶々丸「クール……」
景明「お伺いしますが。 　何ゆえ、自分を伊豆まで連れてこられたの です？」
茶々丸「鎌倉にいたら面倒なことになるからね。 　あて、東都かまくら防衛警備の月番だったもんでさ」
茶々丸「八幡宮の事件はあての不手際だって言えば そう言えるわけで。 　雷蝶あたりから責任追及される前に、先手 打って本拠地に自主謹慎しひきこもったのよ」
景明「……八幡宮の事件……」
茶々丸「足利護氏死す。 　一代の覇王も最期はあっけないもんだ」
景明「それは――確かに？」
茶々丸「表そと向きには隠されてるし、内向きにもまだ 失踪って扱いで捜索中だけどね。 　八幡宮と護衛団ごといなくなって、三日間 経っても手掛かりすら無いんだ」
茶々丸「死亡おなくなりは確定だよ。 　普陀楽じゃ後継者を立てる準備に入ってる」
景明「……」

en.html:
Silver Star had knocked him flying. Whether that blow killed him or not, in the end his body had probably disappeared into the black vortex.
If he never appeared again after that, this was the conclusion.

The Prince Maidono's purpose had been achieved. But... with me unable to return and report, making sense of the situation must be giving him quite some difficulty.

If only that did not put the Prince in danger...

en.html:
House arrest for now?

Back to Kamakura I wanted to go. Everything that had happened at Hachiman Shrine, I had to report to the Prince and the Chief. If the Kubo of Horigoe refused, then break out by force...

From the Kubo's headquarters. A proper military base. Excellent place for a simple escape, naturally.
Without Muramasa recovering, the discussion could not even begin.

Some indirect approach would be better than force, perhaps...

Chachamaru"Lonely development... Apun cannot go back for a while yet."
Chachamaru"But if that is what you want, what to do? Shall I arrange a train? Better than crawling there by boat."
Kageaki"............"

en.html:
Samajh nahin aa raha. I could not work her out.
This general—this girl—what did she want from me?

Enemy? Ally?
Friendly, attached like a little puppy. No hostility or double face that I could sense. But sheltering Silver Star, she herself had admitted that.

Was it true?
If true, why do such a thing?

What was Chachamaru Ashikaga's purpose?

...Too many mysteries.

So many, even which question to ask first was becoming a question. I could start asking as they came to mind. But the answers also—how far could I trust those?

Chachamaru"Normally we play, no game happens. Nobody can hit Princess's pitch. Every ball, catcher goes to hospital. Put her at bat, she hits straight back at the pitcher—home run, pitcher included. Out of the park."
Chachamaru"All players in tsurugi, full armored warriors. No manipulating gravity for Princess—Silver Star. Then somehow a contest becomes possible. Baseball bolte hain, but the thing has gone fully cosmic."
Kageaki"............"
Hikaru"Very exciting. A most entertaining sport."
Chachamaru"So exciting, by the end about half the players cannot stand on both feet. Well, bhai? Interested, obviously."
Kageaki"Not one particle of interest."
Chachamaru"Pity. Well, your tsurugi is under repair. Cannot be helped."
Chachamaru"You look like a baseball man, though."
Hikaru"Correct. Heh heh. Kageaki is quite accomplished."
Hikaru"Locally, he was called the Demon King of Bunting."
Chachamaru"Like being Emperor of Dipping Noodles. Very specialized throne."
Hikaru"What are you saying? His glove toss was divine. And for judging a ball near the line, fair or foul, his reputation was that of a master."
Chachamaru"...This man is overflowing with talents that almost amount to something."

en.html: Her name I called, and without a care she answered. A gulf. That casual manner was what disturbed me most. So natural she could be—HOW? These two years, what had they been to her? Even when both of us were completely covered in tsurugi, I could not ignore that distance between our minds. Facing her without armor, it showed still more plainly. With the same eyes as two years ago, Hikaru was looking at me. As though between us nothing had changed. How could that be? EVERYTHING had changed. If she believed otherwise, that blind belief itself was madness. Mad she was, after all.◆ That was what I thought.◆ What I WANTED to think. Madness had made her the slaughtering Silver Star. That was the explanation I wanted. Accept it, and all I had to do was mourn her terrible fate and fight her.
en.text:
Her name I called, and without a care she answered.

A gulf.

That casual manner was what disturbed me most. So natural she could be—HOW?

These two years, what had they been to her?

Even when both of us were completely covered in tsurugi, I could not ignore that distance between our minds. Facing her without armor, it showed still more plainly. With the same eyes as two years ago, Hikaru was looking at me.

As though between us nothing had changed.

How could that be? EVERYTHING had changed.

If she believed otherwise, that blind belief itself was madness. Mad she was, after all.◆
That was what I thought.◆
What I WANTED to think.

Madness had made her the slaughtering Silver Star. That was the explanation I wanted. Accept it, and all I had to do was mourn her terrible fate and fight her.

ja.html: 名を呼べば、光は屈託のない声を返してくる。 　隔絶。 　何気ない態度こそ、何より違和感を覚えさせられて ならない。 　何故、そんなにも自然の態ていでいられるのか。 　この二年間の出来事は、光にとって何だったのか。 　互いに全身を劒冑で覆って相対していた時でさえも 感じずに済まされなかった心理の隔絶は、素肌で向き 合ってみれば尚一層赤裸々だった。 　光は二年前と同じ目で俺を見ている。 　俺との関係は何も変わっていないと、そう言うかの ように。 　そんな筈はない――何もかも変わった。 　変わらないと信じるなら、その妄信こそ狂気だ。 　光はやはり狂っている。◆ 　そう思う。◆ 　思いたい・・・・。 　狂ったからこそ殺戮の銀星号と化したのだと、そう 思いたい。 　そう思えば、後は光の悲運を嘆いて戦うだけで済む。

名を呼べば、光は屈託のない声を返してくる。

　隔絶。

　何気ない態度こそ、何より違和感を覚えさせられて
ならない。
　何故、そんなにも自然の態ていでいられるのか。

　この二年間の出来事は、光にとって何だったのか。

　互いに全身を劒冑で覆って相対していた時でさえも
感じずに済まされなかった心理の隔絶は、素肌で向き
合ってみれば尚一層赤裸々だった。
　光は二年前と同じ目で俺を見ている。

　俺との関係は何も変わっていないと、そう言うかの
ように。

　そんな筈はない――何もかも変わった。

　変わらないと信じるなら、その妄信こそ狂気だ。
　光はやはり狂っている。◆
　そう思う。◆
　思いたい・・・・。

　狂ったからこそ殺戮の銀星号と化したのだと、そう
思いたい。
　そう思えば、後は光の悲運を嘆いて戦うだけで済む。

en.html: But. If... she was not mad. As she said, if she had done everything in her right mind. Then? That slaughter, that calamity, not madness behind it— HOPE. For these two years, if Hikaru had only been living with single-minded devotion. ...Could such a thing be possible? Not madness. Not hatred. The logic of chasing a wish. Slaughter people with that— destroy the world. ...Possible? Really? And if it was possible—◆ ...What was I supposed to do? My adoptive mother's death. The calamity scattered across Kantou. If all of it had come from Hikaru wanting her father back————
en.text:
But.

If... she was not mad.
As she said, if she had done everything in her right mind.

Then?

That slaughter,
that calamity,

not madness behind it—

HOPE.

For these two years, if Hikaru had only been living with single-minded devotion.

...Could such a thing be possible?

Not madness.
Not hatred.

The logic of chasing a wish. Slaughter people with that—

destroy the world.

...Possible? Really?

And if it was possible—◆

...What was I supposed to do?

My adoptive mother's death.
The calamity scattered across Kantou.

If all of it had come from Hikaru wanting her father back————

だが。

　もしも……狂っていないのなら。
　本人が言った通り、全て正気・・でしたことなら。

　どうなる？

　あの殺戮、
　あの災厄が、

　狂気ゆえではなく――

　希望ゆえに引き起こされたものであったのなら。

　光はただ、この二年を一途いちずに生きていただけである
なら。

　……それは、可能な事なのだろうか？

　狂・ではなく、
　憎・でもなく、

　願いを追い求める理・によって諸人を殺戮する――

　世界を毀こわす。

　……そんな事が可能なのか。

　もしも可能であったなら――◆

　　　　　　　　　　……俺は、どうするべきなのだ。

　養母の死も、
　関東に撒き散らされた災厄も、

　光の、父を求める想いゆえであったのなら――――
